answer: Ghost cruisers filed unpaid timber tallies from a parked truck. A plot pays when the scaler buries a 3.2-kg quartz rod at stake 11 on the published knoll, screws an 18-mm cedar witness disc 1.4 m up the north fir, and files a 16-second increment-borer trace from a 90 m transect, locking 21 POA for 6 epochs. Four desks rebuild the ring spectrogram in 1.1 s and must agree on a 2 mm latewood band plus a 6-degree slope. One key may plant 1 rod per epoch, so 36 aliases lock 756 POA. A reused rod serial, or two traces matching 14 of 16 peak frequencies, burns 12 POA and bars that key for 5 epochs.
